identity.title: Accretion Kinematics through the Warped Transition Disk in HD142527 from Resolved CO(6-5) Observations

question.value: What physical structure underlies the non-Keplerian intra-cavity gas kinematics in HD 142527, as seen in new CO(6-5) data?

evidence.quote: We aim to understand the physical structure that underlies the intra-cavity gaseous flows, guided by new molecular-line data in CO(6-5) with unprecedented angular resolutions.
Based on observations acquired at the ALMA Observatory, through program `ALMA#2011.0.00465.S`.
HD 142527 was observed with ALMA in band 9, at $\sim$700 GHz, during June 2012

findings_qualitative.value: Intra-cavity kinematics consistent with axisymmetric stellocentric accretion near free-fall through a warp to the inner disk

evidence.quote: the kinematics are consistent, to first order, with axisymmetric accretion onto the inner disk occurring at all azimuth.

claims.hypothesis: Intra-cavity flows are stellocentric accretion at all azimuth near free-fall rather than outflow
claims.experiment: Warped, accreting parametric RADMC-3D model compared with CO(6-5) MEM moment maps
claims.result: Model reproduces twist of centroid PA and the inner 110 deg flip, and the isotopologue cavity depth
claims.finding: Accretion at near free-fall with steady-state rate fixed at the stellar accretion rate explains the data

evidence.quote: Stellocentric accretion, starting from the outer disk and reaching close to free-fall velocities, with a steady-state mass flow fixed at the observed stellar accretion, is consistent

claims.hypothesis: Disk tearing by an inclined companion explains the abrupt warp and fast accretion
claims.experiment: Qualitative comparison of break radius estimates with model
claims.result: Estimated a~15 AU consistent with 30 AU breaking radius

evidence.quote: Estimates of $a \sim15$ AU are therefore entirely consistent with a breaking radius of 30 AU, as demanded by our model.

why_this_method.value: MEM deconvolved moments avoid clean-beam broadening of velocity dispersions

evidence.loc: 2.1 Choice of image-plane representations of the visibility data
evidence.quote: We thus chose to base our study on the moments maps inferred from deconvolved (MEM) datacubes.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Outflowing disk wind ruled out because it would twist kinematics the opposite way

evidence.quote: we can rule out an outflowing disk wind

limitations_admitted.value: Model is parametric, not dynamically consistent, no systematic parameter search

evidence.quote: It is not a dynamically consistent model.

referee_caveats_inferred: Model tuned by eye with no goodness-of-fit metric; degeneracies unquantified
Free-fall interpretation relies on assumed temperature and abundance profiles
Astrometric alignment was chosen to symmetrize the centroid, which may bias the interpretation

reproducibility.score_reason: Data have a project code, but calibration and the uvmem imaging are in a companion paper, and the model is hand-tuned without full inputs.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Key results are qualitative model comparisons, and the recipe depends on unreleased code and a companion paper.
